hypothesis: v3 eliminates case-level repetition on the two dense Gaoli commentary pages without regressing healthy pages, holding or improving the paired MTHv2 mean against v2; on passing, the AncientDoc smoke confirms no cross-suite regression.
decision: Withhold the full run because the repetition-binding gate's premise is falsified, not because v3 underperformed. The targeted smoke measured the two Gaoli pages' GOLD at repetition_rate 0.095238 and 0.157895: these are canon catalog pages that legitimately repeat the line 右N經同本異譯 four to six times, so a perfect transcription of GL-1054-1-13 would fail the suite's absolute 0.1 hard limit and the declared zero-repetition target was unsatisfiable on truthful output. The stability of the measured rates across runs and harnesses (0.1739 and 0.2273 within a few points every time) was page structure, not stochastic looping. v3 itself performed well: 4 of 4 sealed, smoke mean 0.316125 versus v2's 0.529125 in the same run, invented characters at 0.0 to 0.0364, and the healthy control read at 0.1172 while the v2 side flaked to 0.8682 on a page it previously read at 0.0816, underscoring single-repeat variance. Next bounded step is a corrected gate: per-case repetition measured RELATIVE to gold repetition, and a suite revision that derives each case's repetition allowance from its gold rather than an absolute constant.
